items.title: Dec. 16 verdict date for Sara Duterte not set by impeachment court — Pangilinan
items.description: Sen. Francis "Kiko" Pangilinan said the Senate impeachment court has yet to set a date for the verdict in Vice President Sara Duterte's trial, contradicting an announcement by court spokesperson Reginald Tongol that the proceedings could end on December 16.

items.title: Loren may rejoin Senate majority – spokesman
items.description: The camp of Sen. Loren Legarda is not ruling out the possibility of the lawmaker returning to the country and joining the majority bloc, saying shifting alliances is a regular feature of the upper chamber’s fluid politics.

items.title: House panel OKs additional P1.95 billion for school safety

items.title: Suspension of China exports to drive up fuel prices

items.title: Impeachment court targets verdict by December 16
items.description: The Senate impeachment court is eyeing to hand down a final verdict in the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte by Dec. 16, running ahead of schedule despite two session cancellations this week.

items.title: DFA rejects China claim over waters off Batanes
items.description: The Department of Foreign Affairs “firmly and strongly” rejected yesterday the Chinese embassy’s assertion that China has sovereign rights and jurisdiction in the waters off Batanes.

items.title: NBI invites VP over ex-cop’s cash delivery claim
